data.headline: MYTH
data.subheadline: If it's everywhere in my feed… it's happening to everyone.

data.title: Sounds right. Brains love loud.
data.body: One dramatic story sticks. Quiet base rates don't. So your brain upgrades "I saw it" into "it's everywhere."

data.myth: If it's everywhere in my feed… it's happening to everyone.
data.fact: Repeat a vivid claim → it feels common → people talk → it feels even more common. Frequency in attention ≠ frequency in reality.

data.title: Catch it today
data.body: Exam rumor: three group chats panic. Base rate? Still one quiz, same week, same curve. Drama traveled. Numbers didn't.

data.subtext: Save this. Comment the bias you catch yourself using this week.

manifest.caption:
Myth: if it's all over my feed, it's happening to everyone.

Fact: that's an availability cascade — loud stories feel common even when base rates barely moved.

Catch yourself today: drama can travel farther than the numbers.
